tellings.link_reason: Both tell of Gus Grissom's 1967 death on the Cape Kennedy pad and the lemon he hung on the capsule.

plain: Before his death in 1967, the astronaut Gus Grissom is said to have hung a lemon on a coat hanger outside his Apollo spacecraft on the launch pad to protest how badly things were working. Joe Rogan, the comedian and podcast host, tells it at second hand, crediting sources that include Grissom's wife. According to Rogan, Grissom said, "We can't even communicate with the tower, how we're ever going to communicate when we're in space." Michels mentions it in passing and says Grissom died the next day. Both tell it as a sign that something about his death, and the programme around it, was wrong.
